@@U02742@@
lords and ladies of the court; in the rear crowded benches for the lesser sort. And lovers, undaunted by the uncanny twilight, cuddle in the shadows. I see all are seated properly now. We may begin. The spirits may enter!

@@U02743@@
(Trumpets.)

@@U02745@@
Let the play begin! It is His Majesty's wish! Walls, open! No hindrance now, magic is at hand! Tapestries disappear as if furled by fire, the wall splits, folds back, and out of nowhere a deep stage appears, bathing us in mysterious light. I now will mount the proscenium.

@@U02747@@
(His head popping out of the prompters box.)

@@U02748@@
I hope you all approve. Prompting, after all, is the Devil’s rhetoric.

@@U02749@@
(To the ASTROLOGER.)

@@U02750@@
You understand the motions of the stars, you'll have no trouble understanding my whispers.

@@U02752@@
Prompted by magic, a temple rises before us, a mighty structure sustained by rows of columns, like 阿特拉斯 supporting the heavens.
translation:
@@U02742@@
宫廷里的贵族和女士们；在后面拥挤的长凳上，为地位较低的人准备。恋人们不畏惧诡异的暮色，在阴影中拥抱。我看到现在所有人都已就座。我们可以开始了。神灵可以进入！

@@U02743@@
（喇叭。）

@@U02745@@
好戏开始吧！这是陛下的心愿！墙，打开！现在没有任何阻碍，魔法就在眼前！挂毯就像被火卷起来一样消失了，墙壁裂开，向后折叠，不知从哪里出现了一个深深的舞台，让我们沐浴在神秘的光芒中。我现在将登上舞台。

@@U02747@@
（他的头从提示框里伸出来。）

@@U02748@@
希望大家能够认可。毕竟，这是魔鬼的言辞。

@@U02749@@
（对占星家来说。）

@@U02750@@
你了解星星的运动，你也能毫无困难地理解我的低语。

@@U02752@@
在魔法的推动下，一座神庙在我们面前拔地而起，这座宏伟的建筑由一排排的柱子支撑着，就像支撑着天空的阿特拉斯一样。
